title: Audit Event (Abstract)
description: Abstract audit event type. Adds actor_id, action, ip_address, and user_agent to the base event payload. The affected resource is identified by subject/subjectType from the base envelope. Concrete audit event types must derive from this type.

action.description: The action performed (e.g. create, update, delete, login, logout).

actor_id.description: Identifier of the actor (user or service) that performed the action.

ip_address.description: IP address from which the action was performed.

user_agent.description: User-Agent string of the client that performed the action.
